name: @formfusion/iban
description: Set of validation rules for worldwide iban numbers used for the formfusion (form management & validation) library

scripts.build: find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name 'node_modules' ! -name 'src' ! -name 'plugins' -exec sh -c 'find "{}" -type f -name "*.js" | read' \; -exec rm -rf {} \; && node esbuild.js

author: Sara Mitevska
